note: Facts published AFTER the 30-Sep-2026 as-of date. Not used in the initiation; kept for the Q2FY27 results update.

facts.fact: Q2FY27 results: revenue Rs2,773 cr (+41% YoY), operating profit Rs197 cr (OPM 7%), other income Rs128 cr, net profit Rs194 cr consolidated (Rs185 cr standalone); H1FY27 standalone PAT Rs495 cr.
Q2FY27 call: average TDI price ~Rs285,000/t; TDI production 8,700 t (July shutdown).
Cabinet approved Rabi 2026-27 NBS rates (outlay ~Rs62,370 cr, DAP farm price unchanged).
Sep-2026 shareholding: promoters 41.30%, FIIs 13.70%, DIIs 9.21%, public 35.78%.
S&P Global headline: India reviews anti-dumping duties on TDI imports from China, Japan and South Korea (sunset review; article not readable, date inferred from URL).
Share price ~Rs466 (weekly close), down ~23% from the 30-Sep-2026 close of Rs604.40.
